headline: Severe Gaza weather system threatens 1.3 million displaced Palestinians with humanitarian disaster
label: NEWS
caption:
A dangerous weather system is putting millions at extreme risk in Gaza 🌧️

According to Anadolu Agency, a severe weather system in Gaza now threatens 1.3 million displaced Palestinians with a deepening humanitarian disaster.

Families are struggling to survive as cold and heavy rain hit fragile shelters and tent camps across the region.

Aid organizations warn that the lack of proper infrastructure and supplies will worsen the suffering of those already displaced by conflict.
